result.description: Managed cloud MongoDB database platform; Atlas Administration API manages projects, clusters, users, and more.
result.auth_detail: Admin API: service accounts (OAuth 2.0 client-credentials, client ID + secret -> bearer access token; recommended) or legacy programmatic API keys (HTTP Digest). Separate delegated user OAuth 2.1 auth-code+PKCE ("Atlas App Connections") exists, but only for approved design partners.
result.access_detail: Gate audit: (1) Per-account credentials (service account or API key) are created by each customer org themselves in Atlas, no app review or listing needed. Delegated OAuth app-connections path is partner-gated, but not required for a toolkit built on user-supplied service-account credentials. (2) Atlas signup is free and the free-forever M0 tier exists. The docs don't restrict Admin API to paid tiers. Caveats: customer must add an IP access list entry (else 403), unless the org enables delegated access. The Admin API does not reach cluster data.
result.api_notes: Versioned REST Atlas Administration API with public OpenAPI spec (projects, orgs, clusters, DB users, network, backups, alerts, etc.), Go SDK and other tooling. Does not give access to data in clusters (needs driver/Data connection). Separate Voyage AI embedding REST API.
